authority.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
authority.rule: R2013+ Spline flags 1 and Knot parameter are BL fields; scenario 1 keeps Rational, Closed, and Periodic as separate B fields.

controls.ac1027: Hand-encoded scenario-2 body with nontrivial flags=13 and knot parameter=2, degree, fit tolerance, tangents and fit points. A BL sentinel follows the exclusive body-bit boundary.
controls.ac1024: Hand-encoded scenario-1 body without R2013+ fields, with separate Rational/Closed/Periodic bits, tolerances, knots, weighted control points, and a following BL sentinel.
controls.encoder: Both vectors use low-level dwgBufferW bitstream primitives and do not call DRW_Spline::encodeDwgSplineBody().
controls.fixturePolicy: Runtime-authored vectors only; no DWG/DXF fixture file was added.

implementation.change: Added a dedicated --spline-bitlong-boundary selector and fast CTest registration for the existing independent-body vectors.

claimBoundary: This control verifies the local parser's version gate and body-cursor boundary against hand-encoded vectors.
It is not an authentic DWG producer witness or independent reader comparison.
AC1024, AC1027, and AC1032 SPLINE producer/version qualification remains open until each has a matching physical witness.
No spline geometry, NURBS evaluation, rendering, or format-support claim is promoted.
